name: BAT-FAM
description: Follow Batman, Alfred, and young Damian Wayne—who has taken on the mantle of Little Batman—alongside a few newcomers to Wayne Manor, as they navigate the fun and frustrations of life as a super family

videos.title: Game Knight
videos.overview: Bruce's plans of having the perfect family-game-night unravel when Damian and Claire become suspicious of their newest family member.

videos.title: Bat Trip
videos.overview: Damian and the Dent twins accidentally unleash parademons when they try to shake their chaperone, Bruce Wayne, on a class field trip to Star-Labs.

videos.title: 90 Is the New 80
videos.overview: Trouble finds Little Batman when he ignores his dad's advice and coerces Afred to become Exo-Bat to help him take down the Mad Hatter.

videos.title: All in a Bat's Day's Work
videos.overview: The Bat-Fam stumbles upon a sinister caper that involves Wayne Enterprises on "Go to Work With a Grown-Up Day".

videos.title: A Knight at the Movies
videos.overview: Bruce decides it's time to let Alicia in on his "little secret"- that he's Batman. However, Alicia has a little secret of her own.

videos.title: The Art of Claire
videos.overview: When an old pal/fellow ex-criminal makes Claire an irresistible offer, she finds herself having to choose between her new life and her old one.

videos.title: Manbatman
videos.overview: After Bruce tells Damian that a crime spree of stolen Goki Cards isn't a big enough caper for the Batmen, Damian teams up with Dr. Langstrom.

videos.title: An Interview with a Batman
videos.overview: Bruce becomes his own worst enemy when he tries to keep E*Vil out of his tightly planned family interview with Vicky Vale.

videos.title: April Fools! (1)
videos.overview: As a dark plot unfolds, it will take every member of the Bat-Fam working together to save Gotham and its citizens.

videos.title: April Fools! (2)
videos.overview: As a dark plot unfolds, it will take every member of the Bat-Fam working together to save Gotham and its citizens.
